Health claims have a higher breach rate due to longer processing times in Medical Adjudication, possibly due to complex case types or external provider delays.
Broker-channel claims have a higher rate of additional document requests, leading to delays and increased SLA breaches.
Team B has a higher rework rate in Verification, which contributes to delays and SLA breaches for claims handled by this team.
